title: Dividers eat drawer width
hook: Which estimate leaves room for four compartments?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Dividers occupy space too. The usable width of each compartment is the drawer width minus the internal walls, divided by the number of compartments.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.

recall.question: A drawer is 50 cm wide inside. Dividers 1 cm thick split it into five equal compartments. How wide is each?
recall.why: Five compartments need four dividers: (50 − 4 × 1) ÷ 5 = 9.2 cm. 10 cm forgets that the walls take up width.
